prompt:
A coin is dropped from rest from the edge of a vertical cliff into the sea. The coin takes 2.60 s to strike the water. Neglect air resistance and use g = 9.81 m s^-2.
(a) Calculate the height of the cliff above the water. [2]
(b) Calculate the speed of the coin immediately before it strikes the water. [1]
hints: Use s = 0.5 g t^2 for part (a).

mark_scheme.criterion: Substitutes into s = 0.5 g t^2: 0.5 x 9.81 x (2.60)^2
